svg.text: (a) DISC LEMMA false: D(q,1/2) misses X, Gam; p in S, |p-q| < 1/sqrt2
(b) DROP test at q: P near q (red) inside the penumbras
(c) DROP LEMMA: certified map over (theta_C, phi_X)
drop meets int X: area 1.10e-03 (> 0); disc terms exact: True
P within 1/sqrt2 of q, outside both penumbras: area 0.0e+00 (drop test kills q)
verified cells: 81 of 81 (green PASS, grey stipple OPEN layer, white pending)
witness: h_u = 17/20, h_v = 199/200, tan(theta/2) = 7/100, X_low = 211/100, phi = 0, A at (11/10, 0), tan(alpha/2) = 1/18, side 387/100 -- every H1-H3 term and every disc term checked in Fractions

T_u dashed, C red, X blue, S = T_u minus C stippled; orange = conv(D(q,1/2) u {p}) (the DROP): it crosses X's corner, so no unit square with this disc and p exists -- the distance form forgot the cone.
(b): penumbra Pi(K) = points p whose drop from D(q,1/2) meets K (K = X's side Xi, C's side Gam); the drop lemma = P n D(q, 1/sqrt2) inside Pi(Xi) u Pi(Gam) for every admissible q.

(c) green only when tree273 CERT/PRUNE on every leaf AND verify273 re-derived it (coverage replay, mpmath cores, shapely penumbras); grey stipple = OPEN (corner theta, phi <= 5 deg or capped): never green.
